title: Vietnamese processor, labor shortage (English)
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): coffee processor, Dak Lak, Vietnam. The regional table does not cover Vietnam, so the regional tool returns nothing and the answer has no regional insight. Its own record and labor peer projects from other synthetic producers still give it full evidence.

turns.message: We can't find enough workers. Several people left for jobs in the city and we are behind on orders.
It got worse over the last six months. We are short about fifteen workers. We raised wages a little and offered transport, but it hasn't been enough.

intake_replies: We also posted the job at the local vocational school, but not many applied.
